area: the AI plan's Time step (time-arcade) and the racing AIs' crystal rule
summary: A new rule for every Time-mode AI, written in MINIGAME_TRAINING_PLAN.md section 6.2 (AI_PLAN.md is not edited): speed over breaking. An AI breaks only what it cannot pass and never leaves a passable ring for a pickup that breaks. It sits beside your learned crystal-detour gene (rule 9, 2026-11-16): that gene is for a crystal that buys speed; this bounds a pickup that breaks. Switchback's Dolphin AI now holds it (planner Passable / KeyOnTheWay, the sense's blast), switch aiSpeedOverBreaking.
why: Yash's rule of 2026-11-17 for AI training in Time game modes; Plan step: time-arcade. Offline it removes every turn-away (about one a race at the I4 gauntlet, 41 per 24 races at I3 Hard) with race times unchanged to within 2 s at I1-I3 and 1-3 s faster at I4.
